# Potential unbounded batch processing

The code batches work in groups of 64, but the total number of entities to embed in a single run is not bounded. In scenarios with a large number of entities marked dirty or pending, this could result in large memory or processing time consumption, impacting performance.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/embed.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.embed.emit_embeddings`
